note: David's inventory, Ingredients tab (video, 31 Oct 2026): 31 ingredients in the game's order. stars = the ingredient's rarity (1-4). Goose Eggs and Bird Eggs showed no Main Sources. 'eat' = the effect when eaten raw (the red + badge in the grid). Text read by OCR. Cooking (David): 3 methods (Grilling, Boiling, Slicing), 73 recipes in the in-game Cookbook; a recipe takes 1-3 ingredients, one per slot; many accept any ingredient of the same category (e.g. Scallop Sashimi: any two Seafood); the dish's star level follows the ingredients' rarity (3x Bird Eggs 2-star -> 3-star Hard-boiled Egg, Attack +105 for 15 min; 3x Goose Eggs 3-star -> 4-star, Attack +130). Rice and Fish Fillet added from David's screenshots (31 Oct 2026, bought from vendors); Fish is a ninth category.

items.name: Boar Meat
items.description: Meat obtained from hunting sturdy Boars. You can get a large quantity at once, but if you don't take care when preparing it, the smell can be quite strong.

items.name: Fox Meat
items.description: Meat obtained from hunting a fox. Since it's a small animal, the amount you can get is limited.

items.name: Aged Game Meat
items.description: Goblins tend to store various supplies in their caves, including food. After discovering that meat left to sit actually tastes better than expected, they began regularly stashing meat in their caves. Most of it rots because they forget about it, but the meat that luckily survives possesses a unique flavor and aroma. Goblins eat the meat without batting an eye even if parts of it have rotted. Therefore, if you cut off only the edible parts after obtaining it, only a surprisingly small amount remains, making it treated as a precious delicacy.

items.name: Conch
items.description: Whelks are delicious whether grilled or boiled. They say if you hold an empty shell to your ear, you can hear the sound of the waves. Interestingly, the sound varies depending on the shape of the shell.

items.name: Goose Eggs
items.description: This egg is characterized by its large size and rich, savory flavor. It is used in various dishes, and its generous portion makes it sufficient for a full meal. Its thick shell makes it easy to store, and when cooked with care, its unique, deep flavor emerges, offering a special culinary experience.

items.name: Leaflet Tomato
items.description: Thanks to its sweet and tangy flavor, it's delicious even without cooking. When the fruit ripens, it's said to hang in clusters like the leaves of a plant. There's an urban legend that it screams when stressed.

items.name: Round Eggplant
items.description: It is an ingredient that boasts a wide variety of flavors depending on the cooking method. Opinions on it are strongly divided, but if cooked properly, you'll be hooked in no time. It was originally smaller, but grew larger as it adapted to its natural environment. It is said that if bred, it could grow to be long.

items.name: Blue Lotus Mushroom
items.description: It thrives in water-rich environments and, when fully grown, resembles a blooming lotus flower. It is said to grow faster in regions with heavy rainfall.

items.name: White Dewblossom
items.description: This herb is said to grow by absorbing the frost beneath the winter snow and drinking rainwater. Because it rapidly loses its vitality once harvested, it is associated with the concept of transience. It is said to possess an extremely pure and clean energy.

items.name: Walnuts
items.description: It is characterized by a fairly hard shell, but it is popular among women for its health and skin benefits.

items.name: Honey
items.description: A natural ingredient diligently gathered by hardworking honeybees. It flows with a sticky consistency, and its sweetness is unparalleled. While it is sometimes added to dishes, be careful not to use too much, as it will overpower the other flavors. It is said that many mercenaries dissolve it in water to cure their hangovers the day after drinking.

eat.effect: [Personal] Restores 5% of maximum HP immediately after reviving.

items.name: Bird Meat
items.description: Meat obtained by butchering a freshly caught bird. Depending on personal preference, some people prefer bird meat over game meat.

items.name: Shrimp Flesh
items.description: A perfect ingredient that's easy to prepare, has a long shelf life, and tastes great. Its firm texture and chewy flavor are exceptional. The crayfish is a cousin of the shrimp. That's why some people mistake baby crayfish for shrimp and eat them.

items.name: Shellfish
items.description: An unfortunate ingredient that serves as easy prey for many animals. It has long been a good source of protein for humans, and there are various dishes made with it.

items.name: Bird Eggs
items.description: A nutrient-rich food obtained from birds. Although it is encased in a hard shell, the inside is very delicate, so caution is advised. A very basic ingredient that can be prepared in various ways, such as eating it raw or boiling it.

items.name: Aqualily
items.description: For a plant, it has a surprisingly chewy texture and a distinctive aroma. It tends to grow almost anywhere as long as the soil is moist

items.name: Waveleaf Cabbage
items.description: A round vegetable with layers upon layers. Because it is inexpensive, it is ideal for bulking up meals. It is often found in forests or fields near the coast. It is one of the vegetables selected by a certain chef as being tasteless.

items.name: Dwarf Potato
items.description: This crop is highly filling and easy to obtain because many people grow it. Legend has it that someone cultivated and ate it to survive in another dimension.

items.name: Cave Mushroom
items.description: This mushroom is lethal if eaten raw. It grows in clusters and is easy to spot due to its distinctive color. While it primarily grows in caves, it can also thrive outdoors in dark, damp environments. Its texture is excellent, even more so than its flavor. Some people enjoy its chewy texture and use it as a meat substitute.

items.name: Wheat
items.description: As the most widely cultivated grain, it is utilized in various ways. The golden waves stretching across wheat fields have a soothing effect on the mind.

items.name: Dried Maneflower
items.description: This herb has a dry, parched appearance. Although it looks as if it might crumble at the slightest touch, its leaves are surprisingly tough. Because it contains extremely little moisture, it is difficult to extract liquid from it. Typically, it is completely uprooted from the ground, dried for an extended period, and ground into powder for use.

items.name: Grave Bellherb
items.description: This is a medicinal herb said to be the embodiment of a deceased soul that has blossomed into a flower. While it is most commonly seen near cemeteries, it can also be easily found in places rumored to be dangerous.

items.name: Peanuts
items.description: second for 5 seconds. A staple among nuts, it is a versatile ingredient used in various applications such as confectionery and baking.

eat.effect: [Personal] Restores 20 HP per second for 5 seconds.

items.name: Beast Meat
items.description: Meat obtained by butchering a freshly caught animal. It can be eaten in various ways depending on how it is cooked.

items.name: Sand Crab
items.description: Lives near or in the sea and occasionally bites the feet of those who come fishing. Most burrow into the sand to hide, making them hard to spot. It is said that when stored frozen, it is best to boil it before eating.

items.name: Radish
items.description: A vegetable with a distinctive sweetness that guarantees a refreshing flavor when used in soups. It is easy to grow and matures quickly almost anywhere, to the point where the labor costs for harvesting and transporting it can exceed the value of the crop itself.

items.name: Whitebloom Carrot
items.description: A crisp vegetable with a certain degree of sweetness. While underground, white flowers bloom on the stems that grow upward depending on the season, making it relatively easy to find even in the mountains. Rumor has it that it is a code word used by those who trade various goods.

items.name: Lantern Gourd
items.description: A vegetable with a strong sweetness that tastes delicious even when simply steamed or roasted. It is used in a wider variety of dishes than one might expect, and it pairs well in soups, snacks, and bread. This squash is not used in events.

items.name: Rock Mushroom
items.description: A unique mushroom that grows only near rocks. Like most mushrooms, it doesn't need sunlight and lives in the shade of rocks, it's as hard as a rock, just like its habitat. It's absolutely inedible raw, it's usually boiled and then cooked further or ground into a spice. It's particularly valuable as a spice.

items.name: Tree Sap Mushroom
items.description: It grows by attaching itself to trees and feeding on their sap. It is non-toxic and suitable for human consumption. Thanks to its adaptability—it thrives anywhere as long as there are trees— it is easy to find.

items.name: Dawn Lanternleaf
items.description: This is a medicinal herb said to grow under the moonlight of dawn. It symbolizes stability and balance, and is used in both cooking and alchemy when seeking stable results. There is a story that it glows as it absorbs the moonlight when bathed in the dawn's moonlight.

items.name: Rice
items.description: This is a major grain with a long history. It requires a lot of care to grow individually, so it is cultivated through professional farming. If not washed properly before cooking, you may end up chewing on stones.

items.name: Fish Fillet
items.description: Meat obtained from freshly caught fish. If not stored properly, it spoils quickly.
